in_hebrew.name: Magda
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Magda הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Hebrew, Magda is derived from the Hebrew word ‘meged’ which means ‘mighty’ or ‘powerful’. It is also a variation of the name Margaret, which has the same meaning in Greek and Latin. In Christian tradition, Magda is associated with the biblical figure of Martha, the sister of Mary and Lazarus.
